sections.changelog:
Added

  • Maximum number of terms to list in the Category and Brand dropdown groups is now configurable (Coverage → Categories in results), so the groups no longer push the product results out of view.

Changed

  • The live dropdown now lists only categories and brands that actually contain products matching the query, and each shows the count of matching products rather than the term's total size. A refined query like "iPhone 11 стекло" no longer surfaces unrelated categories that hold no matching product. Turn either group off entirely with the existing Category / Brand toggles (Coverage → Categories in results).
  • Field-weight and boost-strength controls on the Relevance tab now pair the slider with an editable number box, so a value can be typed exactly instead of only dragged.
